title: Solo dev: a hacker-heist game played inside a fake operating system. AI art and audio, interface built with Electron, PixiJS and CSS
author: Evox1405
selftext:
I'm a solo dev working on Tracked, a strategic hacker heist game you play entirely inside a fictional operating system called Relay OS.



A job starts with a message and incomplete intel. You probe the target, choose a route through relays (each one changes latency, Trace resistance and how visible you are), get in and move the file. Then the real decision starts: keep going while the Trace climbs, clean up evidence first, or get out in time? Everything happens on the desktop (Terminal, network map, Vault, process monitor, messages and notes), with the mouse or by typing commands when speed matters.



\*\*How AI fits in\*\*



\- Art (illustrations, portraits, logos, news images): made with OpenAI's image generation, then selected and edited by me

\- Music and sound effects: made with Adobe Firefly, then selected, edited and mixed

\- The game runs on Electron. The interface itself (windows, terminal, panels, route lines, animations) is built with CSS and PixiJS, not generated images

\- Nothing is generated while you play, and the game doesn't connect to any AI service

\- The gameplay in the video is recorded from the real game



\*\*Planned for the full game (Q2 2027)\*\*



\- A story campaign built from connected investigations

\- Recurring contacts and morally gray factions that remember how you work

\- Lasting consequences: The Wire reports on what you did, and targets and opportunities change with it

\- Scripting and specialized AI tools inside Relay OS that take over routine work. This is a designed game mechanic, not a live AI

\- Operations in several stages, rival operators, and defending your own rig and the infrastructure you build



The demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in February 2027. Until then I'm looking for a few playtesters (Windows, about 30 to 45 minutes, free Steam key). Comment or DM me if that sounds like your thing.
